findings.text: §11's Change records the new key on the promoted row "through the same record seeding in `reckon/run_record.py`" and names no other site, but a promoted row's keys are declared in `reckon/ledger.py` `RECORD_FIELDS` (ledger.py:112, holding `boundary_waiver` at :173 and `resume_waiver` at :174), and `tests/test_record_fields_declare_every_key.py` asserts the union of keys over mounted ledger rows is a subset of that tuple — so a node that follows §11 literally leaves `RECORD_FIELDS` stale and the first real waiver-bearing promotion turns that standing test red
